Overview:
𝐁𝐫ü𝐜𝐤𝐧𝐞𝐫 𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐧𝐛𝐚𝐮 is the global market leader in film stretching technology – enabling high‑performance packaging and technical films for a wide range of industrial applications. Our lines stand for engineering excellence, reliability, and outstanding quality. But we go beyond machines: we take a holistic view of processes, develop future‑ready solutions, and support our customers worldwide with a strong service mindset. At the same time, our people are at the heart of Brückner. A collaborative culture, room for innovation, and modern, secure workplaces form the foundation for technological leadership and long‑term perspectives.
